PUBLIC NOTICE
The adopted county tax budget for calendar year 2027 for Ashland County is available for public inspection on weekdays at the County Commissioners’ Office, 110 Cottage Street, Ashland, Ohio 44805, between the hours of 8:00 A.M. and 4:00 P.M, excluding holidays.
This notice is posted on Ashland County’s Internet Web Site and may be accessed at www.ashlandcounty.org
By Order of the Ashland County Commissioners
By: Nikki Hiller, Clerk

- WARNING - SCAM TO STEAL YOUR SNAP BENEFITS
- WARNING - SCAM TO STEAL YOUR SNAP BENEFITS
If you are contacted by phone or receive a text message stating that you must call back immediately or your EBT account will be suspended, this is an attempt to steal your SNAP benefits. To protect your SNAP benefits, never share your card number or PIN unless you are calling the EBT customer service line directly, 1-866-386-3071.
